text:
Apple reported revenue above consensus,
led by services and wearables. Management flagged foreign-exchange headwinds
and softer demand in parts of Greater China.

Microsoft delivered revenue slightly above
expectations. Azure growth slowed modestly, but margins stayed strong and
management highlighted AI infrastructure demand.

Tesla reported automotive revenue below
expectations and announced additional price pressure. Management emphasized
energy storage progress but warned that vehicle margins could stay under
pressure.

JPMorgan posted better-than-expected net
interest income and solid trading revenue. Management modestly raised its
outlook but flagged consumer credit as an area to monitor.
